description.value: Florence Motel is an independently operated motel in Smithers, BC offering a range of kitchen-equipped studios, bachelor suites, two-bedroom suites, and standard queen rooms, each with a private entrance and self-contained heating and cooling. Situated along Highway 16 (Yellowhead Highway) in the heart of Smithers, it puts touring cyclists within walking distance of pubs, fast food, a laundromat, and convenience stores, and within easy reach of outdoor pursuits including trails, skiing at Hudson Bay Mountain, and local hiking. The variety of kitchen-equipped units makes it a practical and flexible stop on a long-distance touring route through northwestern BC.
